
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/hnzhengfy/p/23672963/WebSocket" title="发布于 2026-11-26 15:34">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">从“反复追问”到“主动推送”：WebSocket 实时通道详解和 C# 代码示例</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        WebSocket 的“简单”是表面的。连上很容易，但心跳保活、断线重连、消息可靠性、优雅停机……每一个都比“建立连接”复杂很多。这篇文章就从协议原理走到简单实践，用简单易懂的示例项目来展现 WebSocket 的各个特点。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2 class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i118.39f22988q17IGz">〇、前言</span></h2>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i118.39f22988q17IGz">WebSocket 的“简单”是表面的。连上很容易，但心跳保活、断线重连、消息可靠性、优雅停机……每一个都比“建立连接”复杂很多。</span></p>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i118.39f22988q17IGz">这篇文章就从协议原理走到简单实践，用简单易懂的示例项目来展现 WebSocket 的各个特点。</span></p>
<h2 class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i118.39f22988q17IGz">一、为什么实时推送需要 WebSocket</span></h2>
<h3 class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">1.1 传统 HTTP 的先天不足</span></h3>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>HTTP 是“客户端问、服务端答”的请求-响应模型：连接的生命周期由请求驱动，服务端无法在没有请求的情况下主动把数据塞给客户端。</strong></span>要实现“服务端有事件就立刻通知客户端”，早期只能靠几种变通手段：</span></div>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">短轮询（Short Polling）</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：客户端每隔几秒发一次请求。实现简单，但延迟取决于轮询间隔，且绝大多数请求返回"没有新数据"，带宽和连接开销被白白消耗。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">长轮询（Long Polling）</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：服务端挂起请求直到有数据或超时。延迟降低，但每次推送后都要重建连接，服务端要长期占用线程/连接资源，消息量大时成本陡增。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">SSE（Server-Sent Events）</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：基于 HTTP 的单向流，服务端能持续推。它轻量、走普通 HTTP 语义，但只能"服务端→客户端"，浏览器端 API 也相对受限。</span></li>
</ul>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">当业务需要</span><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">低延迟、高频、双向</span></strong></span><span class="qk-md-text complete">的交互（协同编辑、在线游戏、交易行情、设备遥测、AI 流式输出）时，这些方案都会<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>力不从心</strong></span>。</span></div>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph">&nbsp;</div>
<h3 class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">1.2 WebSocket 的协议本质</span></h3>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><span class="qk-md-text complete"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)">WebSocket（RFC 6455）在一条 TCP 连接上</span><span style="background-color: rgba(241, 196, 15, 1)">建立</span></span><span class="qk-md-strong complete" style="background-color: rgba(241, 196, 15, 1)"><span class="qk-md-text complete">持久、全双工</span></span><span class="qk-md-text complete"><span style="background-color: rgba(241, 196, 15, 1)">的通信信道</span>：客户端与服务端都能随时主动发送数据帧，无需再走请求-响应配对。</span></span></strong></div>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">它的建立过程很巧妙——借用 HTTP 完成升级握手：</span></div>
<ol class="qk-md-ol" start="1">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">客户端发起普通 HTTP GET，携带&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Upgrade: websocket</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><code class="qk-md-code">Connection: Upgrade</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><code class="qk-md-code">Sec-WebSocket-Key</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><code class="qk-md-code">Sec-WebSocket-Version</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;等头。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">服务端返回&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">101 Switching Protocols</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;与&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Sec-WebSocket-Accept</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">（由 Key 与固定 GUID 计算得出），协议切换完成。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">之后这条 TCP 连接不再走 HTTP 语义，而是进入 WebSocket 帧（Frame）通信：包含 FIN/RSV/Opcode、掩码位、载荷长度与扩展数据。客户端→服务端的帧必须掩码，服务端→客户端不掩码；Opcode 区分文本、二进制、Ping（心跳请求）、Pong（心跳应答）、Close 等。<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)">（注意：收到 Ping，应当尽快回一个 Pong）</span></span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)">关闭时通过 Close 帧完成四次"握手式"关闭流程</span>，携带状态码（如：1000 正常、1001 离开、1008 策略违规、1011 内部错误）。</span></li>
</ol>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">工程上需要牢记三点：</span><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">消息可能分片</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">（必须循环接收直到&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">EndOfMessage</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">）、</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">Ping/Pong 用于保活与探活</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">升级握手是一次 HTTP 请求</span></strong></span><span class="qk-md-text complete">，因此可以复用现有的路由、认证、网关与 TLS 基础设施（</span><code class="qk-md-code">wss://</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;即 TLS 上的 WebSocket）。此外，WebSocket 也可以跑在 HTTP/2 之上（RFC 8441），获得头部压缩与多路复用，Kestrel 与主流浏览器已支持自动协商，此时握手使用 CONNECT 而非 GET 。</span></div>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph">&nbsp;</div>
<h3 class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">1.3 它到底解决了什么</span></h3>
<div id=":r1b5:" class="qw-table-v2-section" tabindex="-1" data-scroll-left="false" data-scroll-right="false">

</div>
<h2 class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">二、WebSocket 接口的核心特性、适用场景与选型边界</span></h2>
<h3 class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">2.1 接口层面的核心特性</span></h3>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">持久连接 + 服务端主动推</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>连接建立后，服务端可在任意时刻下发消息</strong></span>，这是“推送类接口”的根本前提。</span></p>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">双向命令通道</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>客户端可在同一条连接上发送&nbsp;</strong></span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong><code class="qk-md-code">subscribe</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><code class="qk-md-code">unsubscribe</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><code class="qk-md-code">ack</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><code class="qk-md-code">ping</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、业务指令，形成“订阅-推送”闭环，而不必再开一套 HTTP 接口。</span></strong></span></p>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">低帧开销、支持二进制</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：适合<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>高频小消息</strong></span>（行情、传感器）与<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>大块二进制</strong></span>（文件分片、protobuf）。</span></p>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">与 HTTP 生态可互通</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：握手阶段可走中间件做鉴权、限流、日志；</span><code class="qk-md-code">wss</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;复用 443 端口，对防火墙友好。</span></p>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">无内置消息语义</span></strong></span><span class="qk-md-text complete"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)">：WebSocket 只规定“帧”，不规定“消息格式、订阅、确认、重传”。</span>这些必须由应用层协议补齐——这也是它最容易被低估的地方。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">2.2 典型适用场景</span></h3>
<ul style="list-style-type: square">
<li><span class="qk-md-text complete"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)">实时看板与监控大屏</span>（指标流、告警流）</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete">本质是<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>“读多写少 + 大扇出 + 数据可聚合”</strong></span>。 一个数据源对应 N 块屏幕，数据本身是时序指标，旧值没意义，最新值才有意义。</span></p>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete">典型链路：采集（Prometheus / OTel / 业务埋点）→ 聚合与降采样服务 → WS 网关 → 大屏前端。</span></p>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete">替代方案：如果确定是纯单向、不需要动态订阅，SSE 更省事（浏览器原生自动重连、走标准 HTTP 语义、易过企业代理）。但 SSE 做动态主题订阅要靠 URL 参数重建连接，且 HTTP/1.1 下同源 6 连接限制会卡住多面板场景。</span></p>
<ul style="list-style-type: square">
<li><strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">交易/行情/订单状态推送、充电桩与 IoT 设备遥测</span></strong></li>
</ul>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete">行情类：高频、有序、扇出极大；；订单状态类：低频、语义重、强一致；IoT 遥测（充电桩这类）：海量连接 + 受限设备。</span></p>
<ul style="list-style-type: square">
<li><strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">聊天、协同编辑、在线游戏状态同步</span></strong></li>
</ul>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete">特点：<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>双向、有会话状态、需要服务端权威</strong></span>。</span></p>
<ul style="list-style-type: square">
<li><span class="qk-md-text complete"><strong>长时间任务进度通知</strong>（构建、导出、AI 推理过程流式返回）</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete">特征很鲜明：<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>一次连接对应一次任务生命周期</strong></span>，消息类型混合（进度、日志、结果、错误），时长不可预测（几秒到几十分钟）。</span></p>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete">为什么适合 WS：<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>进度只能服务端主动推；时长未知不适合轮询；还需要双向</strong></span>（取消任务、追加输入、调整参数）。</span></p>
<ul style="list-style-type: square">
<li><strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">移动端/桌面端的常驻通知通道</span></strong></li>
</ul>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete">移动端后台不可靠：iOS / Android 会冻结或杀后台进程，网络切换后连接必然断。真正保证后台到达的只能是系统推送（APNs / FCM / 国内厂商通道）。WS 的定位是“前台/活跃期间的实时通道”，不是后台推送替代品。</span></p>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete">桌面端更适合常驻（Electron / WinUI / WPF）：可以长期运行，但要处理<strong>休眠唤醒、网络切换</strong>（Wi-Fi ↔ 有线 ↔ 蜂窝，IP 变了必须重连）、<strong>系统代理与证书变化</strong>。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">2.3 什么时候不该用它</span></h3>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">只需服务端单向推、且希望极简</span></strong></span><span class="qk-md-text complete">：SSE 更省事，还能享受浏览器自动重连与 HTTP 中间件生态。</span></p>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">需要强类型契约、多语言互通、流控与拦截器体系</span></strong></span><span class="qk-md-text complete">：gRPC（含双向流）更合适，某些场景可作为 WebSocket 的替代方案 。</span></p>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">不想自己处理重连、回退传输、分组广播、Hub 抽象</span></strong></span><span class="qk-md-text complete">：官方明确建议大多数应用优先使用 SignalR 而非裸 WebSocket，因为它提供传输回退与 RPC 编程模型，且多数情况下性能没有显著劣势 。</span></p>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">设备侧受限网络、需要 QoS 与遗嘱消息</span></strong></span><span class="qk-md-text complete">：MQTT 更贴合。</span></p>
<h2 class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">三、一个“生产级”WebSocket 推送接口该怎么设计？</span></h2>
<h3 class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">3.1 端点与消息契约设计</span></h3>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>建议 URL 语义化，并按业务分域</strong></span>，例如：</span><code class="qk-md-code">wss://api.example.com/ws/realtime?channel=market</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。握手可用查询串或子协议（</span><code class="qk-md-code">Sec-WebSocket-Protocol</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">）传递令牌，但更推荐<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>握手时用一次性 ticket</strong></span>（HTTP 接口先换取短时效 ticket），避免长期令牌出现在 URL 与日志中。</span></div>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><span class="qk-md-text complete">消息统一用</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">信封（Envelope）</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">结构，便于路由、追踪与演进：</span></span></div>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph">
<pre class="language-json highlighter-hljs"><code>{
  "type": "market.tick",        // 消息类型：事件 / 命令 / 回执
  "channel": "market",          // 订阅频道
  "seq": 10293,                 // 服务端单调序号，用于去重与补推
  "ts": "2026-11-15T10:20:30.123Z",
  "payload": { "symbol": "BTCUSDT", "price": 68000.5 }
}</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="contain-layout-style relative mb-4 flex min-h-[2em] flex-col rounded-12 bg-capsule qw-md-code">
<div class="rounded-[12px] bg-[#fff]"><span class="qk-md-text complete">命令类消息（客户端→服务端）至少应包含：</span><code class="qk-md-code">subscribe（订阅）</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;/&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">unsubscribe（取消订阅）</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;/&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ack（确认）</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;/&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ping（心跳）</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">；服务端→客户端应包含：</span><code class="qk-md-code">welcome</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">（含连接 id、服务器时间）/&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">pong</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;/&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">error</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;/ 业务事件。协议版本建议放在信封或子协议中（如：</span><code class="qk-md-code">realtime.v1</code><span class="qk-md-text complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">），方便灰度演进。</span></span>
<table style="width: 99.4661%; height: 413.109px">
<thead>
<tr style="height: 21px">
<th style="width: 12.9819%; height: 21px" align="left">专有名词</th>
<th style="width: 22.619%; height: 21px" align="left">核心定义</th>
<th style="width: 64.3991%; height: 21px" align="left">架构作用与 C# 落地场景</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr style="height: 44.0156px">
<td style="width: 12.9819%; height: 44.0156px" align="left"><strong>subscribe / unsubscribe</strong><br>(订阅/取消订阅)</td>
<td style="width: 22.619%; height: 44.0156px" align="left">客户端向服务端表达数据兴趣的指令。</td>
<td style="width: 64.3991%; height: 44.0156px" align="left"><strong>作用</strong>：实现发布/订阅（Pub-Sub）模式，按需接收数据。<br><strong>C# 落地</strong>：服务端通常用 <code>ConcurrentDictionary</code> 维护连接与主题（Topic）的映射关系。</td>
</tr>
<tr style="height: 44.0156px">
<td style="width: 12.9819%; height: 44.0156px" align="left"><strong>ack</strong><br>(确认)</td>
<td style="width: 22.619%; height: 44.0156px" align="left">Acknowledge 的缩写，消息接收确认机制。</td>
<td style="width: 64.3991%; height: 44.0156px" align="left"><strong>作用</strong>：保证消息可靠投递，防止网络丢包。<br><strong>C# 落地</strong>：服务端下发关键事件后启动定时器，超时未收到 <code>ack</code> 则触发重试。</td>
</tr>
<tr style="height: 44.0156px">
<td style="width: 12.9819%; height: 44.0156px" align="left"><strong>ping / pong</strong><br>(心跳机制)</td>
<td style="width: 22.619%; height: 44.0156px" align="left">维持长连接活性的探测信号。</td>
<td style="width: 64.3991%; height: 44.0156px" align="left"><strong>作用</strong>：穿透网关空闲超时限制，检测连接是否存活。<br><strong>C# 落地</strong>：底层对应 WebSocket 的控制帧（Opcode <code>0x9</code>/<code>0xA</code>），服务端收到后刷新最后活跃时间戳。</td>
</tr>
<tr style="height: 42px">
<td style="width: 12.9819%; height: 42px" align="left"><strong>welcome</strong><br>(连接欢迎)</td>
<td style="width: 22.619%; height: 42px" align="left">连接建立后服务端下发的首条控制消息。</td>
<td style="width: 64.3991%; height: 42px" align="left"><strong>作用</strong>：下发全局唯一的 <code>connectionId</code>（用于定向推送和日志追踪）和 <code>serverTime</code>（用于客户端校准时间差）。</td>
</tr>
<tr style="height: 42px">
<td style="width: 12.9819%; height: 42px" align="left"><strong>error</strong><br>(错误通知)</td>
<td style="width: 22.619%; height: 42px" align="left">结构化的异常反馈消息。</td>
<td style="width: 64.3991%; height: 42px" align="left"><strong>作用</strong>：在鉴权失败、格式错误时返回错误码，而非直接粗暴地断开连接，便于客户端做降级处理。</td>
</tr>
<tr style="height: 44.0156px">
<td style="width: 12.9819%; height: 44.0156px" align="left"><strong>业务事件</strong><br>(Business Events)</td>
<td style="width: 22.619%; height: 44.0156px" align="left">真正的业务数据推送（如订单状态变更）。</td>
<td style="width: 64.3991%; height: 44.0156px" align="left"><strong>作用</strong>：承载核心业务载荷（Payload）。<br><strong>C# 落地</strong>：需标准化封装，包含 <code>eventType</code>、<code>timestamp</code> 等字段，通过 <code>System.Text.Json</code> 动态解析。</td>
</tr>
<tr style="height: 44.0156px">
<td style="width: 12.9819%; height: 44.0156px" align="left"><strong>信封模式</strong><br>(Envelope Pattern)</td>
<td style="width: 22.619%; height: 44.0156px" align="left">一种消息结构设计模式。</td>
<td style="width: 64.3991%; height: 44.0156px" align="left"><strong>作用</strong>：将协议控制字段（版本、追踪ID）与业务载荷（Payload）严格分离，互不干扰。<br><strong>C# 落地</strong>：通常实现为泛型类 <code>MessageEnvelope&lt;T&gt;</code>。</td>
</tr>
<tr style="height: 46.0312px">
<td style="width: 12.9819%; height: 46.0312px" align="left"><strong>子协议</strong><br>(Subprotocol)</td>
<td style="width: 22.619%; height: 46.0312px" align="left">在 WebSocket 握手阶段协商的应用层协议。</td>
<td style="width: 64.3991%; height: 46.0312px" align="left"><strong>作用</strong>：利用 <code>Sec-WebSocket-Protocol</code> 头部进行版本协商。<br><strong>C# 落地</strong>：客户端传入 <code>['realtime.v1']</code>，服务端据此路由到对应的处理器，实现灰度演进。</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
<h3 class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">3.2 连接生命周期与状态机</span></h3>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">把连接当作有状态资源管理：</span><code class="qk-md-code">Connecting → Open → (Subscribed) → Closing → Closed</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span><span class="qk-md-text complete">要点包括：</span></div>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">接入即注册</span></strong></span><span class="qk-md-text complete">：连接 id、订阅集合、最后活动时间、发送队列、序号计数器集中管理（连接注册表）。</span></p>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">读写分离</span></strong></span><span class="qk-md-text complete"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)">：一个读循环（接收命令）+ 一个写循环（消费发送队列）</span>，避免并发写同一个 socket 造成帧交错。</span></p>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">优雅关闭</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)">应用停机时向所有连接发送&nbsp;</span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><code class="qk-md-code">1001 Going Away</code></span><span class="qk-md-text complete">，让客户端切换到新实例；<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)">异常断开要清理注册表</span>，防止连接泄漏。</span></p>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">管道不能提前结束</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：在 ASP.NET Core 中，使用 WebSocket 时必须在连接期间保持中间件管道运行；若后台服务负责写数据，常用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">TaskCompletionSource</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;让请求委托等待，且绝不能用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Task.Wait</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">/</span><code class="qk-md-code">Task.Result</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;阻塞 。</span></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">3.3 可靠性：心跳、重连、去重与补推</span></h3>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">心跳</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>服务端周期性 Ping（或应用层&nbsp;</strong></span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong><code class="qk-md-code">ping</code></strong></span><span class="qk-md-text complete"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>），超时未收到 Pong 即判定死链并回收。</strong></span>ASP.NET Core 的 WebSocket 中间件可配置&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">KeepAliveInterval</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">（发送 ping 帧频率，默认 2 分钟）与&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">AllowedOrigins</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;；也可在&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">AcceptWebSocketAsync</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;时按连接设置&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">KeepAliveTimeout</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;。</span></p>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">客户端重连</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>指数退避 + 抖动（如 1s、2s、4s…上限 30s）</strong></span>，重连后携带&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">lastSeq</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;请求补推，服务端按序号回放环形缓冲中的消息。</span></p>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">幂等与去重</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：客户端按&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">seq</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">/</span><code class="qk-md-code">messageId</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;去重；关键指令要求服务端&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ack（Acknowledgement 确认应答）</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，未确认则重发（带幂等键）。<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>客户端为每条关键消息生成全局唯一的幂等键（通常是 clientSeq 或 messageId），发送后放入待确认队列，启动定时器。</strong></span></span></p>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">至少一次 vs 最多一次</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>明确语义并写进文档。</strong></span>行情类可容忍丢弃（</span><code class="qk-md-code">DropOldest</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">），订单/告警类必须持久化 + 确认 + 补推。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">3.4 背压、并发与资源约束</span></h3>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">每连接有界队列</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">System.Threading.Channels</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;的有界通道承载出站消息，<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>队列满时按策略丢弃最旧或拒绝</strong></span>，绝不无界堆积导致 OOM（Out Of Memory 内存耗尽）。</span></p>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">慢消费者隔离</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>单个连接写超时或积压不应拖垮全局</strong></span>；必要时对该连接降级或断开。</span></p>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong><span class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">限制消息大小与分片数</span></span><span class="qk-md-text complete">：防止恶意超大帧耗尽内存；接收侧边收边判长度。</span></strong></span></p>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">避免阻塞 IO 与锁竞争</span></strong></span><span class="qk-md-text complete">：全链路 async/await，注册表用并发集合，序列化复用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">JsonSerializerOptions</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;缓存。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">3.5 安全设计</span></h3>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">传输加密</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：生产环境只允许&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">wss://</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></p>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">来源校验</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：浏览器对 WebSocket&nbsp;</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">不执行 CORS 预检、也不遵守&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Access-Control</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;头限制</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">，但会发送&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Origin</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，因此服务端必须自行校验 Origin 白名单（ASP.NET Core 可通过&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">AllowedOrigins</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;配置） 。</span></p>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">鉴权与授权</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>握手阶段校验 ticket/JWT，连接后按频道做订阅授权</strong></span>（防止越权订阅他人数据）。</span></p>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">限流与配额</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>按连接/用户限制消息速率、订阅数、队列长度</strong></span>；对入站 JSON 做 <span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>schema 校验</strong></span>，避免注入与解析炸弹。</span></p>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">审计与脱敏</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>日志只记元数据（连接 id、类型、耗时），不记敏感载荷。</strong></span></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">3.6 可观测性与运维</span></h3>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">暴露连接数、订阅数、入站/出站消息速率、发送队列深度、丢弃计数、心跳超时数、端到端延迟直方图；<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)">为每条消息携带&nbsp;</span></strong></span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><code class="qk-md-code">traceId</code></span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;贯穿 HTTP 与 WebSocket 链路；<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>提供&nbsp;</strong></span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong><code class="qk-md-code">/health</code></strong></span><span class="qk-md-text complete"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>&nbsp;与“连接详情”诊断接口</strong></span>，便于灰度与故障定位。</span></div>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph">&nbsp;</div>
<h3 class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">3.7 部署与横向扩展</span></h3>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">粘性会话或集中式网关</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>多实例下同一用户的连接应稳定落到同一节点（或引入网关层）</strong></span>。</span></p>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">跨节点广播</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：用 Redis Pub/Sub、消息队列或一致性哈希做<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>“节点间转发”</strong></span>，本地注册表只负责本节点连接。</span></p>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">反向代理配置</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：Nginx/负载均衡需支持&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Upgrade</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">/</span><code class="qk-md-code">Connection</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;透传，并调大空闲超时；容器编排中配置合理的探针与优雅停机窗口。</span></p>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">移动端注意</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：长连接影响耗电与后台保活，需结合平台推送（APNs/FCM）做兜底。</span></p>
<h2 class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i127.39f22988q17IGz">四、.NET 10 实现一个可运行的实时推送示例</span></h2>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph">本此示例代码，使用 ASP.NET Core Minimal API + 原生 System.Net.WebSockets，并用到 .NET 10 新增的 WebSocketStream 能力。</div>
<p>.NET 10 在库层面引入了 WebSocketStream，把 WebSocket 抽象成真正的 Stream，可直接与 StreamReader、JsonSerializer、PipeReader/PipeWriter 等流式生态协作，减少手动处理缓冲、分片与 EndOfMessage 的样板代码 。</p>
<pre class="language-yaml highlighter-hljs"><code># 示例项目结构如下
RealtimePush.sln
├─ PushServer                 # 服务端（ASP.NET Core）
│  ├─ Program.cs
│  ├─ Contracts/RealtimeMessage.cs
│  ├─ Contracts/JsonOptions.cs
│  ├─ Connections/RealtimeConnection.cs
│  ├─ Connections/ConnectionManager.cs
│  ├─ Services/MarketTickerService.cs
│  └─ Services/ConnectionJanitor.cs
└─ PushClient                 # .NET 客户端（控制台）
   └─ Program.cs</code></pre>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px"><em>示例代码 github 地址：<a title="https://github.com/chengzijia357/Test.WebSocket.RealtimePush" href="https://github.com/chengzijia357/Test.WebSocket.RealtimePush" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/chengzijia357/Test.WebSocket.RealtimePush</a></em></span></p>
<p>运行结果和对应的效果：</p>

<h2 class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i125.39f22988q17IGz">五、小小的总结</span></h2>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph">
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i124.39f22988q17IGz">WebSocket 用一次 HTTP 升级握手换来一条持久、全双工的 TCP 信道，让服务端从“被动应答”变为“主动推送”，以极小的帧开销支撑聊天、行情、监控、设备遥测、AI 流式输出等低延迟双向场景；它的代价是不提供消息语义——订阅模型、信封契约、序号与去重、心跳保活、断线重连与补推、背压与限流、Origin 校验与&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">wss</code></strong></span><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i117.39f22988q17IGz"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>&nbsp;加密、跨节点广播与粘性会话，都需要在应用层自行设计并写进文档。</strong></span>因此在选型上，单向简单推送可考虑 SSE，强类型多语言流式通信可考虑 gRPC，希望免去重连与传输回退细节则优先 SignalR，只有对协议、性能与形态有精细控制需求时，裸 WebSocket 才是最优解。</span></p>
</div>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i114.39f22988q17IGz">在 .NET 10 中实现这套能力非常直接：<code class="qk-md-code">app.UseWebSockets()</code>&nbsp;接入中间件并配置心跳与 Origin 白名单，端点内&nbsp;<code class="qk-md-code">AcceptWebSocketAsync</code>&nbsp;后以"读循环 + 写循环 + 每连接有界通道"的方式管理生命周期，用&nbsp;<code class="qk-md-code">BackgroundService</code>&nbsp;承载业务推送源，并借助&nbsp;<code class="qk-md-code">TaskCompletionSource</code>&nbsp;或 await 读循环保持管道存活、用优雅停机通知客户端迁移；新增的&nbsp;<code class="qk-md-code">WebSocketStream</code>&nbsp;还能把 WebSocket 当作&nbsp;<code class="qk-md-code">Stream</code>&nbsp;与&nbsp;<code class="qk-md-code">JsonSerializer</code>、<code class="qk-md-code">StreamReader</code>、<code class="qk-md-code">PipeReader</code>&nbsp;无缝协作，进一步削减分片与缓冲的样板代码。本文的示例项目正是把这些要点串成可运行闭环：<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>服务端每秒主动推送行情，客户端完成订阅、心跳、指数退避重连与消息打印，直观呈现了 WebSocket 在实时性与双向交互上的优势，以及生产级推送通道必须补齐的可靠性与可运维性设计</strong></span>。</span></div>

</div>
